text:
liam: seeing p99 jump ~+220ms after the tokenizer encoding change rolled (v5-enc) around 2026-03-18T09:11Z. Spike is concentrated on gpu-a pool. KV cache miss rate jumped ~3x on those hosts. snippet from infra logs: ```[2026-03-18T09:13:02Z] ERROR KVCache: miss=0.71 hit=0.29 model=v5-enc-2026-03-18 host=gpu-a-12``` any immediate ideas?

deploy-bot: rollout v5-enc started by sara at 2026-03-18T09:10Z -> canary 10% at 09:10:30 -> 100% at 09:11:05

marta: can we get kernel-decider traces + batcher histograms for the window 09:05-09:20? also grep the kernel-decider decisions for quant/int routes: `rula query "kernel_decider" --since 15m | jq '.decision' | sort | uniq -c`

cheng: uploaded a quick sampling profile to s3: s3://redwood-perf-samples/2026-03-18/v5-enc-sample-09h13/flame.svg. early read: kernel selection is flipping more often (int8 -> fp16) because median seq_len moved ~48 -> ~92 in the canary traffic. that explains more expensive kernels firing and higher p99.

sara: confirmed tokenizer change introduced a normalization tweak for some multi-byte chars (emoji + CJK sequences) — encoding density increased ~15% for our telemetry inputs. also, the encoder now emits slightly different prefix bytes which breaks some of our KV cache prefixing assumptions -> keys miss.

liam: quick repro I ran locally: ```# compare tokenization
python -c "from encoder import encode_v4, encode_v5; s='😊'*100; print(len(encode_v4(s)), len(encode_v5(s)))"``` v4 -> 104 tokens, v5 -> 186 tokens for the same input (yikes).

opsbot: autoscaler: observed burst at 09:12, added 4 preemptible nodes to gpu-a pool, removed 2 at 09:28. throughput stayed flat, but tail latency remained high until 09:36.

marta: mitigation proposal: 1) pin tokenizer normalization -> rollback v5-enc for canary immediately; 2) add a kernel-decider guard rule: if seq_len median > 80 then prefer fp16 kernel to avoid oscillation; 3) temporarily increase kvcache fallback TTL and emit extra metrics for kv hit/miss per model variant.

cheng: I can push a small kernel-decider hotfix (one-line guard) + add unit that simulates dense encoding in ~30m. will also add 1m histogram emission for seq_len and token_density so we can alert on shifts.

sara: rolling canary back to v4 now :thumbsup: will watch kv hit-rate and seq_len histogram. will post updates in this thread.

liam: thanks all — please open an incident doc and a short postmortem once we stabilize. if p99 doesn't return to baseline by EOD ping me and we'll escalate.
